statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 18% sits in the low band and Stress 50% is elevated, with the BOJ hike absorbed through a weaker yen and the Ueda press conference under way.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The BOJ hike printed on a 7-2 vote with two dovish dissents and the yen weakened rather than strengthened, which removes the carry-unwind mechanism that would normally justify broad protection around this decision. Conditional risk is therefore concentrated in two narrow windows rather than across the session: the Ueda press conference now under way, and the 13:30Z-15:00Z US cash open on quadruple-witching expiry. Outside those windows the observed overnight structure is a narrow two-way range and Tail remains below the block threshold.
headline: NQ futures hold a narrow overnight band near 29,885 as a dovish-tilted BOJ hike weakens the yen; Ueda press conference and quad-witching expiry frame the day's two risk windows
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73% (+501.92 points), in a broad relief rally after Wednesday's 25bp Federal Reserve hike to 3.75-4.00%, the first US increase in more than two years, with VIX down 12.8% to 15.44. The Bank of Japan then raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25% at 02:45Z, a 31-year high, but the vote was 7-2: board members Toichiro Asada and Ayano Sato both dissented, arguing that inflation is not yet demand-driven and that growth risks are skewed lower. That dovish tilt reversed the pre-decision yen trade. USD/JPY has risen to 157.08, up 0.71% and at two-week yen lows, and the Nikkei 225 gained 1.9% to 65,332. A weaker yen after a hike is the opposite of a carry unwind, so the transmission channel that makes a central-bank second leg dangerous for mean-reversion strategies is not currently active. NQ December futures trade near 29,885, about +0.48%, inside a narrow 29,804-29,890 band, roughly 0.29% wide; price sits close to the top of that band but the range is tight and retracement has remained available, so structure is two-way rather than one-way. Cross-assets are not aligned for a persistent directional path: the 2-year yield is unchanged at 4.69% and the 10-year is 4.94%, up 0.2bp; VIX is low; and crude is falling for a third session at $100.33 WTI and $103.02 Brent as Middle East supply concerns ease. Tail is therefore held at 18% in the low band. Stress is 50% because two independent catalysts remain unresolved: Governor Ueda's press conference from 06:30Z, where the live hawkish path is an explicit link between yen weakness and inflation, and the US session, where Industrial Production at 13:15Z, Fed Governor Bowman at 13:30Z and the cash open land together on September quadruple-witching expiry. That expiry settles at the 20:00Z cash close. CME index futures then halt for the weekend at 21:00Z, which removes any live price path and lowers both conditional Tail and Confidence across the final nine forecast hours.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 17-26% and Stress decayed from 64% to 44% as the post-Fed relief rally matured and then quietened. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday at the US cash open, where trend-up structure was most pronounced. Tail fell back through the afternoon as retracements reappeared, and from 22:00Z the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound mode with Tail 17-18% and Confidence steady near 87%, with Stress ticking up at 04:00Z as the BOJ decision approached.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry two narrow conditional-risk peaks. Tail moves into the watch band at 07:00Z where the Ueda Q&A overlaps the European cash open, then eases through the European morning as the BOJ message is digested. The second and larger peak is the US expiry session: Tail reaches 24% at 13:00Z around the cash open and the single hour mapped to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES is 14:00Z at Tail 25%, covering the 30-90 minutes in which opening continuation is confirmed or rejected. A secondary Stress peak accompanies the 20:00Z quadruple-witching settlement. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 13-15% and Confidence eases into the solid band.
